title: Exploring liquid and recurrent neural networks
title_de: Liquid Neural Networks und rekurrente Modelle erkunden
summary: Model implementations, examples and comparisons from liquid-nn-playground.
summary_de: Modellimplementierungen, Beispiele und Vergleiche aus liquid-nn-playground.

blocks.text: The playground brings together liquid neural network models and recurrent baselines, including LTC, CfC, NCP, Liquid-S4 and LrcSSM. It includes Python and notebook examples, datasets and benchmark configurations.
blocks.text_de: Der Playground vereint Liquid Neural Networks und rekurrente Vergleichsmodelle, darunter LTC, CfC, NCP, Liquid-S4 und LrcSSM. Er enthält Python- und Notebook-Beispiele, Datensätze und Benchmark-Konfigurationen.
